item.title: HNTR Follows Up Viral Remix with Collaboration Featuring Oscar Winner, Juicy J
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's episode, where we dive into the world of EDM and catch up with the rising star, HNTR. This Toronto-native made his Electric Daisy Carnival debut in Las Vegas, and his music has been taking the dance world by storm.
[Cut to interview clip]
Host: HNTR, congratulations on your EDC debut. Last year, your remix of Cloonee and InntRaw's "Stephanie" was the talk of the festival. What was it like watching that song blow up?
HNTR: Honestly, it was unreal. I made that remix just for fun, and to see it go from a bootleg in my sets to a record being played by pretty much everyone was crazy. It changed my career and gave me confidence that there's a real audience for the sound I'm building.
Host: That's amazing. And now, you've released a new track, "Holla At A Player", featuring Juicy J. What's next for you?
[Cut to interview clip]
HNTR: I'm a producer and DJ from Toronto, where hip hop and dance music come together. I've always believed that blending these genres could work, despite what others said. It's taken years of learning, experimenting, and figuring out what HNTR sounds like, but it's paying off.
Host: Well, it's definitely paying off. We're excited to see what's next for you, HNTR. Thanks for chatting with us today.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for this week's episode. If you want to hear more from HNTR, check out his new track, "Holla At A Player", and follow him on social media. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
